description: Published admissions facts for one selective school: magnet and boarding high schools (for example Phillips Exeter, Stuyvesant, NCSSM, Lawrenceville) and selective colleges (for example MIT, Yale, UVA). Returns admission rates and counts, application requirements, deadlines, cost and aid facts, each with its source and the date EduAvenues checked it, plus a link to the free EduAvenues school guide. If the name matches more than one school, returns the candidates to choose from. For TJHSST, use tj_admissions_facts.

school.description: School name or common short name, e.g. "Exeter", "Stuyvesant", "MIT"

name: school_admissions
title: Selective school admissions facts
